---
title: Rules
---

Rules report problems in a BibTeX project.
Run `biblint rule` to list them, or `biblint rule <name>` for one rule's summary.

## Rule reference

| Rule | Default | Fix             | Purpose                                                     |
| ---- | :-----: | :-------------: | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `syntax_error`  | yes     | none            | BibTeX syntax is incomplete or unbalanced.                  |
| `formatting`  | no      | safe/configured | The file would be reformatted by biblint.                   |
| `missing_key`  | yes     | none            | An entry has no citation key.                               |
| `key_format`  | no      | none            | An existing key differs from the configured key formula.    |
| `duplicate_key`  | yes     | none            | A citation key is used more than once.                      |
| `duplicate_doi`  | no      | none            | Two entries share a DOI.                                    |
| `duplicate_citation`  | no      | none            | Two entries share a normalized citation fingerprint.        |
| `duplicate_abstract`  | no      | none            | Two entries share an abstract fingerprint.                  |
| `duplicate_field` | yes     | none            | An entry repeats a field name.                              |
| `empty_field` | yes     | none            | A field has no value.                                       |
| `nonstandard_name_separator` | yes     | none            | A name-list field uses `with` or a comma before `and`.         |
| `invalid_suppression` | yes     | none            | A suppression comment is malformed, misplaced, or obsolete. |
| `unsupported_escape` | yes     | none            | A character has no built-in LaTeX escape.                   |
| `unsupported_construct` | yes     | none            | Source was preserved because it could not be structured.    |

`syntax_error` has error severity.
Most other structural problems are warnings; preserved source and unsupported characters are notes.

`nonstandard_name_separator` checks `author`, `editor`, `translator`, and `collaborator` values.
It only examines text outside nested braces, does not rewrite values, and does not inspect prose fields such as `title` or `note`.

## Inline suppressions

A standalone `% biblint-ignore <rule> [<rule> ...][: <reason>]` comment suppresses the named rules for the next BibTeX entry:

```bibtex
% biblint-ignore nonstandard_name_separator duplicate_field
@book{garfinkel1997,
  author = {Simson Garfinkel with Gene Spafford},
}
```

The reason after `:` is optional.
Multiple comments before one entry are also combined.
Suppressions cannot hide syntax errors or whole-file formatting diagnostics.
Malformed, misplaced, or unused directives are reported by `invalid_suppression`.

Formatting is not enabled for `check` by default because it is a mechanical rewrite rather than a content diagnostic.
Use `check --format` to include it, select `formatting` in `biblint.toml`, or use `format --check` as a formatting-only gate.

## Selecting rules

```toml
[lint]
select = ["duplicate_key"]
extend-select = ["key_format", "duplicate_doi"]
ignore = ["unsupported_escape"]
```

`select` replaces the default set.
`extend-select` adds rules, and `ignore` takes precedence.
Use `all` as a wildcard.
Per-file exceptions use the same rule names:

```toml
[lint.per-file-ignores]
"generated/**" = ["formatting", "unsupported_construct"]
```

## Project-level checks

When checking a directory or multiple files, biblint also detects duplicates across files.
DOI, citation, and abstract rules are disabled by default; enable only the comparisons useful for the project.

## Key-format checks

`key_format` is disabled by default because changing a citation key can break references elsewhere.
Enable it explicitly:

```toml
[lint]
extend-select = ["key_format"]

[lint.key-format]
style = "better-bibtex"
```

The rule reports a suggestion but does not rename keys automatically.
See [Citekey generation](key-generation.md) to configure the formula.
